For color lovers, decorators, or anyone who wants some variety, you might enjoy this mod! [b]You don't need any mod loaders or launchers to use this mod![/b] It's a simple drag and replace.

The Junimo Plush! It's so adorable and perfect for decorating your Stardew home. If you're reading this and wondering "Omg! There's a junimo plush?!" Yes! It's a bit of an Easter Egg to get it. To acquire it please read [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/5699n4/junimo_plush_found_by_me_and_dig_nameless1/]here[/url]. 

Anyways so while adorable it only comes in one color, [color=#00ff00]green[/color]. I love to theme my house so I decided to make some recolors of the plushie for myself and whoever else wants them. There is a rainbow of colors available as you can see in the above images. Download one or download them all for future changes. At this time there is no way to change the color in game - you must change the file in SV's folder each time you want a different color.

[b]In Game:[/b]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/IEaxRXP.jpg?1[/img]



[b][u]HOW TO INSTALL
[/u][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Go to your Steam content folder at \Steam\Steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Tilesheets. From there copy 'furniture.xnb' and paste it in a non gaming folder such as My Documents as a backup (This is just a standard precaution)
[*]Look at the attachments carefully. Find the one labeled with the color you want. Download the mod from the attachment to this post. Unzip the file, it contains the new furniture xnb
[*]Copy the new furniture xnb file into your Steam content folder, again at \Steam\Steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Tilesheets. Say yes to Replacing the original furniture xnb file
[/list]
[b]If you would like to use the xnb or the png file in conjunction with other mods, please ask me first. This mod uses the furniture xnb file, which many other decorative mods do as well. If you want the png file to combine them with your own, please ask[/b]

[b]And that's it! [/b]Enjoy your new junimos. If you want to switch back to normal, just drag the backup furniture xnb file back into the folder. [b]Enjoy, tell your friends, and keep decorating![/b]
